description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for MediaKeySession and its factory within the Rialto media server component. It includes class constructors, destructors, and method signatures related to media key session management, including license handling, decryption, and key management.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of MediaKeySession.

classes.name: MediaKeySession
classes.description: Implements the IMediaKeySession interface and manages media key sessions, including license requests, decryption, and key management.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionFactory::createMediaKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new MediaKeySession instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::MediaKeySession
methods.description: Constructor for MediaKeySession, initializing with key system, session ID, ocdm system, session type, client, LDL flag, and main thread factory.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on init data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with response data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID is contained within the session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::onAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Handles event when all keys are updated.
